sections.content: INSERT adds rows: INSERT INTO table (columns) VALUES (...). Multiple rows in one statement is faster than many single inserts.
Omit columns with defaults; use RETURNING (Postgres) to get generated ids back. Always parameterize values — never concatenate user input.
Key points: column list prevents order mistakes, NULL inserts need explicit NULL keyword, and bulk inserts beat row-by-row loops.
